## Key findings
- **Chinese models occupy 5 of the top 10** by token volume: Tencent Hy4 preview (#2), Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash (#3), DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (#4), Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 (#5), DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (#6), DeepSeek V4 Flash 0423 (#7), Tencent Hy3 (#8). (7 of top 10 if counting all DeepSeek/Tencent/Z.ai/Xiaomi variants.)
- Only GPT-5.6 Luna (OpenAI, #1), Nemotron 3 Ultra (Nvidia, #9), and Gemini 3.8 Flash (Google, #10) are non-Chinese.
- Methodology caveat (stated on page): rankings measure **adoption (token volume), not quality**; they describe traffic routed through OpenRouter, not the whole market or provider-native APIs.

- `authoritative: yes` — OpenRouter is the vendor whose own platform produces the live usage data; defensible as a primary source for OpenRouter token-share. Note: live/vendor data (snapshot date Sep 13, 2026).
